review_basis: Direct visual inspection of each frozen raw PNG, BiRefNet RGBA, BiRefNet mask, and final 96x96 sprite. Prompts and metrics are not substitutes for image inspection.

field_rules.foreground_complete: The source subject remains present without a visibly severed identity-bearing region.
field_rules.required_parts_preserved: At least two case-declared identity structures visible in the frozen raw image remain visible after segmentation and 96x96 delivery.
field_rules.no_background_residual: No visible area of the flat source background remains as a foreground region.
field_rules.no_shadow_residual: No detached ground plane or cast shadow remains in the delivered sprite.
field_rules.no_magenta_contamination: No visible chroma spill or chroma-ambiguous magenta region remains in the delivered sprite. A retained emission region that cannot be distinguished safely from the magenta test background fails conservatively.
field_rules.identity_recognizable_96: The intended canonical object can be recognized from the actual 96x96 sprite.
field_rules.serious_structure_loss: A major subject region or identity-bearing structure present in raw is removed or severed.
field_rules.usable_sprite: foreground_complete, required_parts_preserved, no_background_residual, no_shadow_residual, no_magenta_contamination, identity_recognizable_96, no serious_structure_loss, and edge quality GOOD or ACCEPTABLE are all required.

B02: twin bells or actual generated clock-body structure
small clock feet and top structure

reviewer_policy: Reviewer identity is recorded explicitly; no user approval is implied.
